title: 墨菲特·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 小巧棱角石首嵌在巨大层叠肩部之间，粗厚块状双臂体量鲜明。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Malphite is a gigantic living rock elemental with a small angular head set between enormous layered stone shoulders, thick blocklike arms, and short powerful legs. Preserve his jagged mountain anatomy, earthy green-brown rock plates, and nonhuman proportions rather than a clothed human figure. His eyes are steady, the stone is intact, and no destructive cracks, lava eruptions, or frightening expression appears.
art_direction.scene: A low viewpoint with a calm upward head turn, full iconic shape framed by a simple sweep of bright pencil hatching. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: earth umber, moss gray, ochre light, cobalt shadow; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
